title: Markets: regional AI outlook and Lucid deliveries
summary: A thin markets edition today: two evidence-backed items, a World Bank regional forecast and Lucid’s reported quarterly production and delivery totals.

stories.headline: East Asia and Pacific Sees Steady Growth Amid Global Uncertainty
stories.dek: The World Bank projects 4.5% regional growth in 2026, while saying AI adoption and gains remain uneven.
tldr: The World Bank projects East Asia and Pacific growth of 4.5% in 2026, citing high-tech goods exports and global AI-related activity as contributors.
Its regional update says AI uptake among firms and individuals is rising but remains uneven, with costs, skills and security concerns cited as barriers.
The forecast is an institutional projection, not a realized growth figure.

body.text: The World Bank’s October update projects regional growth at 4.5% in 2026. It says high-tech goods exports have benefited from the global increase in AI-related activity, while adoption across the broader economy remains uneven.

The Bank identifies infrastructure, skills, financing, security and privacy concerns among the conditions shaping wider AI uptake. CNBC’s coverage also reports the revised regional outlook and AI concentration concerns.

stories.whyItMatters: The outlook ties regional growth to the supply chain for AI-related goods while highlighting that production gains and economy-wide adoption are not the same.
stories.editorNote: Forecast and adoption statements are attributed to the World Bank’s October 6 economic update.

stories.headline: Lucid Announces Q3 Production and Deliveries, Sets Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings
stories.dek: Lucid reported 3,806 deliveries and 2,954 vehicles produced in the third quarter as it reduced inventory.
tldr: Lucid reported 3,806 vehicle deliveries and 2,954 vehicles produced in the third quarter of 2026.
The company said deliveries exceeded production as it reduced existing vehicle inventory under an operating reset.
The release presents production and delivery totals; Lucid said its broader financial results would come with its earnings announcement.

body.text: Lucid’s October 5 filing exhibit reports 3,806 deliveries and 2,954 vehicles produced for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company said deliveries exceeded production while it worked through existing inventory.

CNBC separately reported the quarter’s delivery decline and production adjustment. Vehicle delivery counts alone do not establish the company’s full financial performance, which Lucid said would be reported later.

stories.whyItMatters: The figures provide an operating snapshot of an EV maker’s inventory reset, while the company’s financial results remain pending.
stories.editorNote: No investment conclusion is drawn from the operating figures; the company itself cautions that they are not a sole indicator of quarterly financial results.
